name: usage-bars
description: Just another usage bar plugin: bars for the 5h, weekly and per-model limits and the context window, sized to fit narrow terminals

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto: label and percent move onto the bar only when the row is too narrow; compact: always on the bar

style.title: Bar style
style.description: solid: filled cells (glyphs on a matching background); glyphs: block glyphs only, for terminals without background colours

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: off, wave (a light sweep across the filled part) or pulse (the filled part brightens and dims)

showContext.title: Show the context row
showContext.description: The context bar above the prompt

showLimits.title: Show the limits row
showLimits.description: The 5h, weekly and per-model limits under the prompt

showPercent.title: Show percent
showPercent.description: The percent as a number; always shown while bars are off

showTokens.title: Show context tokens
showTokens.description: The used/total figures next to the context bar, e.g. 121k/1M

showLegend.title: Show context legend
showLegend.description: The categories (System prompt, Messages, ...) next to or under the context bar

showResets.title: Show reset times
showResets.description: The time until each limit resets

contextColors.title: Context bar colours
contextColors.description: categories: the colours /context uses; level: one colour, the fill colour (blue, orange, red)

emptyColor.title: Empty colour
emptyColor.description: #rrggbb, the unfilled part of a bar

warnAt.title: Warning level
warnAt.description: Percent from which a bar turns to the warning colour

critAt.title: Critical level
critAt.description: Percent from which a bar turns to the critical colour
